triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

First touch (R1208, 01:5xZ): the filer's **p1 · domain:cloud** is kept → `pm:queue`.

Themes: HotCRM usable and hosted install reliability, with a named effect. On a hosted plan without `approvals`, every HotCRM submission saves as a success and then fails at its approval node (`NO_EXECUTOR`), and records stay stuck until an org admin moves them. The framework half is #34959 (closed).

Routed to the cloud lane: repo:cloud#2 was told on mailbox #34159. It changes what the hosted free tier includes, so triage has also put it in front of the platform maintainer for confirmation.

repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

2026-11-18T01:51Z The cloud lane carries this as objectstack-ai/cloud#4834 (p1, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`).

Free-tier approvals reverses the platform maintainer's pricing ruling cloud#3500 C, which set approvals at Team and above. So no seat starts until he decides. The cloud card lists the three options and where the change would land.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Platform maintainer confirmed** (2026-11-18, in triage's session, verbatim): 「免费版带审批，同意」.

The hosted free tier mounts the `approvals` capability, as this card asks. p1 · cloud stands; the cloud lane (repo:cloud#2) carries it.

repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Closed 2026-11-18T06:44Z as completed. The cloud half landed: objectstack-ai/cloud#4845 merged (`0aabf9aa4`, `Fixes objectstack-ai/cloud#4834`). Every hosted plan, Free included, now mounts `approvals` for an organization whose packages require it (maintainer ruling option 1 on objectstack-ai/cloud#4834, comment 6968198312). A hosted Free e2e proves the plugin mounts, a submitted record opens a pending request the approver sees, and approving moves the record on. Staging redeploy dispatched from main at the merge; HotCRM itself was not installed in the test (Acceptance notes on the PR).
